$comment: Field list for the KMS local JSONL audit trail (crate/access/src/audit/, feat/audit_and_siem, PR #934). Field names below are the REAL names emitted by the KMS, verified against the sample line shared in PR #934: {"id":0,"timestamp":"2026-07-20T19:02:25.605113314Z","operation":"Create","user":"admin","object_uid":"...","algorithm":"AES","client_ip":"127.0.0.1","result":"Success","duration_ms":4,"request_id":"...","prev_hash":"...","row_hash":"..."}. They differ from the originally-requested conceptual names (event_type/actor/object_id) — the mapping is recorded in 'conceptual_alias' below for traceability.

fields.name: id
fields.description: Monotonically increasing sequence number of the audit row.

fields.name: timestamp
fields.description: RFC 3339 timestamp with nanosecond precision, UTC (Z suffix).

fields.name: operation
fields.description: KMIP operation name (e.g. Create, Encrypt, Decrypt) or "kmip" for malformed/unrouted requests.

fields.name: user
fields.description: Authenticated user id (or default_username) performing the operation.

fields.name: object_uid
fields.description: UUID of the targeted KMIP object. Null when the operation could not be routed to an object (e.g. malformed request).

fields.name: algorithm
fields.description: Cryptographic algorithm of the targeted object, when known.

fields.name: client_ip
fields.description: Caller IP address (direct peer, or trusted reverse-proxy XFF value).

fields.name: result
fields.description: "Success", or an object {"Failure": "<http status + reason>"} on error. Polymorphic — normalized to result_status/result_detail before ingestion into either backend, see .mise/scripts/test/validate_audit_compat.py.

fields.name: request_id
fields.description: Correlation id for the originating HTTP request.

fields.name: prev_hash
fields.description: Hash of the previous audit row (hash-chain, tamper-evidence).

fields.name: row_hash
fields.description: Hash of this row, computed over its fields + prev_hash.
